body.name: encH
body.def: \(\operatorname{enc}_H(\zeta)\) concatenates, in the topological and lexicographic orders of \(G_H^N\), the masks \(R,F,h\), the restricted-growth-string district code, prefix codes of every context-labelled circuit \(K_{s,D}\), the indexed constraint list \(\mathcal J\), the complete fields of every \(\sigma\)-, \(\varphi\)-, \(\ell\)-, and \(r\)-token, and the normalized denominator list. All alphabets, response rows, circuit nodes, and token lists are finite.
